settings.text: Application tips from the JOSS Cosmetics team — everything you need for a flawless, even, long-lasting finish.

settings.title: How to apply the cream
settings.text:
1. Prep the skin. Our formula works beautifully even without special rituals. Optionally, 10–12h before, do a gentle scrub and moisturise dry areas.

2. Shake the bottle to ensure the formula is perfectly blended.

3. Apply a sufficient amount to clean, dry skin. Place small dots over the body and spread right away across larger areas for a smooth, even result.

4. Perfect result. One layer is enough for a beautiful, rich effect — multiple layers are not recommended.

settings.title: Adding depth & dimension
settings.text: Apply over the cream where you want extra definition. Build gradually and blend with a brush or sponge for a sculpted, natural-looking glow under bright lights.

settings.title: Locking in the shimmer
settings.text: Dust the gold-brown shimmer over the finished tan to set everything in place and catch the light. A little goes a long way — apply in light, even layers.
